races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but DIVOT arrives at the top of his game so is taken to bag a third victory of the summer at the chief expense of Alazwar who scored under Brodie Hampson at Beverley last time. Recent Brighton scorer Wrist Art and in-form maiden Warrnambool can also play a prominent role.

  1. DIVOT
  2. ALAZWAR (IRE)
  3. WRIST ART (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
STORM FORCE quickly made up for lost time when an impressive scorer at Southwell after a long absence and can follow up here at the chief expense of Frantic.

  1. STORM FORCE (IRE)
  2. FRANTIC
  3. GOLD STAR GAZING (IRE)

races.name: Daly Accounting Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
READER has posted some fair form and looks to have been found an excellent opportunity to gain a first win. Nothing But Love is the danger.

  1. READER
  2. NOTHING BUT LOVE
  3. FOR EVER HOPEFULL (IRE)

races.name: Tips For Every Race At raceday-ready.com Handicap
races.verdict:
DONTSPOILASALE has slipped to an attractive mark and caught the eye here last time so is fancied to gain a first win for Jim and Suzi Best with market confidence likely to prove highly significant. Elvetham could emerge as the main threat.

  1. DONTSPOILASALE (IRE)
  2. ELVETHAM (IRE)
  3. FLETCHER'S FLIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
HOPE RISING has been hit with an 8 lb hike but Jamie Snowden's thriving mare still looks hard to beat here as she bids to extend her winning sequence to four. Ed Walker's Thirsk scorer La Peregrina appeals as the one to chase her home.

  1. HOPE RISING (IRE)
  2. LA PEREGRINA
  3. PERCY JONES

races.name: Mo's Mile Handicap
races.verdict:
MUSICAL SOLDIER has been progressing well since the cheekpieces went on and looks well-in under a penalty for his win here last week. Laughterintherain is narrowly preferred to Ahead of Fashion for the forecast spot.

  1. MUSICAL SOLDIER (IRE)
  2. LAUGHTERINTHERAIN (FR)
  3. AHEAD OF FASHION

races.name: Racing Partnership Celebrating 10 Years Handicap
races.verdict:
PHOENIX MOON has run poorly on her last 2 turf starts but her record over C&D is second to none, so she's taken to bounce back with a bang. Horace Wallace has a good chance if confirming his return to form, while recent C&D winner Balon d'Or remains well treated on past exploits.

  1. PHOENIX MOON (IRE)
  2. HORACE WALLACE
  3. BALON D'OR

races.name: Rapido Racing LTD Conditions Arab Stakes
Matchbook Betting Exchange Supporting UK Racing Handicap
races.verdict:
LONDON IS BLUE found only one too good for the second time in his last 3 starts at Lingfield 17 days ago, making his move wide on the home turn and running out of steam late on. A dual C&D winner as a juvenile, he's up to winning races from this mark and earns the vote down in grade. My Mate Mackley and Loleeta are others to consider in a competitive opener.

  1. LONDON IS BLUE
  2. MY MATE MACKLEY
  3. LOLEETA

races.name: Bet 20 Pounds Get 40 Pounds In Free Bets At matchbook.com Restricted Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
NORFOLK BLUE surely won't get a better chance to open his account than this. Inspectre may offer most resistance.

  1. NORFOLK BLUE (IRE)
  2. INSPECTRE (IRE)
  3. MUCHACHO (IRE)

races.name: MatchbookLovesRacing 'Confined' Handicap
races.verdict:
MAKES ME WONDER stuck really well to his task when second at Lingfield 17 days ago and eased slightly in class, he possesses very solid claims. Jenson Benson's reappearance was a good one so he's a definite threat, with Thundering Breeze expected to be much more competitive this time.

  1. MAKES ME WONDER
  2. JENSON BENSON (IRE)
  3. THUNDERING BREEZE (IRE)

races.name: Follow Matchbook On X Handicap
races.verdict:
Having finally got off the mark in July, HIGHLAND HARVEY has continued in good nick and given he was a shade better than the result when third over C&D last week, he looks ready to go in again. There is depth to this low-grade contest, though, with Clipsham Noble and La Trinite expected to be involved.

  1. HIGHLAND HARVEY (IRE)
  2. CLIPSHAM NOBLE (IRE)
  3. LA TRINITE

races.name: Download The Matchbook App Handicap
races.verdict:
SHES GOT THE BLUES finished with running left when third at this course last month and gets the nod in an open-looking contest. King David and Rainbow Sign rate the principal dangers.

  1. SHES GOT THE BLUES (IRE)
  2. KING DAVID (IRE)
  3. RAINBOW SIGN

races.name: Streamline Supports The Martlets Hospice Handicap
races.verdict:
SERENITY DREAM proved himself as good as ever when scoring over C&D last month and may be able to defy a further rise in the handicap here. Station Bar and Dion Baker are feared most.

  1. SERENITY DREAM (IRE)
  2. STATION BAR
  3. DION BAKER (IRE)

races.name: Streamline Taxis - Always Going The Distance Handicap
races.verdict:
This can go to DIOMED SPIRIT, who was only narrowly denied a second victory for Chris Gordon here last week and is able to race off an unchanged mark. Mr Cool and Bona Fortuna can also make their presence felt.

  1. DIOMED SPIRIT
  2. MR COOL (IRE)
  3. BONA FORTUNA (IRE)

races.name: Napoleons Casino And Restaurant Leeds Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Possible to make a case for most of these. HIS FINEST HOUR posted 2 good placed efforts in Class 4 events here for his new yard here last month and can resume winning ways in this slightly lower grade. Cosmos Raj bounced back to form out of the blue at Redcar recently and his good course record provides hope that he can build on that. Fellow Ripon specialist Poet's Dawn also has to enter calculations.

  1. HIS FINEST HOUR
  2. COSMOS RAJ
  3. POET'S DAWN

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
EMPRESS PRINCESS shaped well when second on last month's Beverley debut and is taken to go one better now. American Psycho hasn't fully confirmed the promise of his opening second to Orthodox in 2 subsequent outings but is still the obvious danger unless the betting speaks in the favour of well-bred newcomer Kumharas.

  1. EMPRESS PRINCESS (IRE)
  2. AMERICAN PSYCHO (IRE)
  3. KUMHARAS

races.name: 21 Engineer Regiment Sapper Nursery
races.verdict:
STAR PEOPLE saw off the rest comfortably when narrowly denied at Newcastle recently so even a 3 lb rise may not stop him if showing up in similar form. If Beverley novice winner Lexington Bloom can continue his trend of race-by-race improvement he may provide the chief threat ahead of Lady Dublin.

  1. STAR PEOPLE (FR)
  2. LEXINGTON BOOM
  3. LADY DUBLIN

races.name: Ripon Yorkshire's Garden Racecourse Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
YES I'M MALI is 1 lb lower than when narrowly denied in a higher grade at Thirsk on Friday so a bold bid looks assured if showing up in similar form. Spirit of Applause is another who arrives on the back of a recent near miss and is second choice ahead of Kind Touch, a still unexposed 3-y-o who returns to the track where he made a winning debut a year ago.

  1. YES I'M MALI
  2. SPIRIT OF APPLAUSE
  3. KIND TOUCH (IRE)

races.name: Ripon Yorkshire's Garden Racecourse Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ALMARADA PRINCE has been knocking on the door in stronger races than this at Yok lately and looks ready to win for Paul Midgley. Mister Sox, a dual C&D winner, and Educating Rita were better than the result over C&D on Great St Wilfrid day and head the dangers along with Here Forever, a lightly-raced 3-y-o who leaves the impression he has bigger performances in him.

  1. ALMARADA PRINCE (IRE)
  2. MISTER SOX
  3. EDUCATING RITA

races.name: attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
DONNA NOOK is back on the mark she defied here in June and may be able to deny Garden Oasis an eighth C&D success. Milford Grange and Paroda Diva complete the shortlist.

  1. DONNA NOOK
  2. GARDEN OASIS
  3. MILFORD GRANGE

races.name: Wakeman Stayers Handicap
races.verdict:
FEMME FATALE has upped her game since going over 2m and is taken to defy a small rise for Lingfield, perhaps at the main expense of fellow 3-y-o Si White, who wasn't that far behind her at Lingfield. Last year's winner Regally Blonde should also be on the premises.

  1. FEMME FATALE
  2. SI WHITE (GER)
  3. REGALLY BLONDE

races.name: Book Hotel & Conferencing At Wolverhampton Racecourse Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
FEDERAL ENVOY has had excuses on all 3 starts since his good second at Ripon in June and could well be worth chancing from his reduced mark in a switch of headgear. Nutcracker has been running well in classified company of late and heads up the dangers back in a handicap. Velvet Skies and R P McMurphy complete the dangers.

  1. FEDERAL ENVOY (IRE)
  2. NUTCRACKER
  3. VELVET SKIES (IRE)

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JESSICA showed much more than on debut when second in a stronger contest at Newmarket 11 days ago and with further progress distinctly possible from this well-related filly, she makes most appeal. Phalanx Nation, on return from a break, rates the lead danger partnered by Billy Loughnane, with Iris Olivia next best.

  1. JESSICA (IRE)
  2. PHALANX NATION (IRE)
  3. IRIS OLIVIA (IRE)

races.name: Race And Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Maiden Handicap
races.verdict:
MEDIA LEGEND shaped well with a view to stepping back up in trip when third following 3 months off at Newbury 18 days ago and he's of interest dropping into class 5 company for the first time. A return to all-weather may see Master of Entropy in a better light and he's also considered under Billy Loughnane, with Norman Invasion another who likely remains capable of better.

  1. MEDIA LEGEND (IRE)
  2. MASTER OF ENTROPY
  3. NORMAN INVASION

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 Handicap
races.verdict:
KNOWLEDGE has disappointed on turf since making a winning debut on the all-weather but is worth another chance off a tempting mark back on this surface. Variety Act is potentially a big threat given his trainer's excellent record with handicap debutants.

  1. KNOWLEDGE
  2. VARIETY ACT (GER)
  3. LUCKY LUNA (IRE)

races.name: Visit wolverhampton-racecourse.co.uk To Book Now Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
PIPILY's most recent run was too bad to be true so she is worth another chance as her narrow defeat at Newmarket the time before reads very well. The thriving Midnight Media must be respected, while Magic Runner needs keeping an eye on off a dangerous mark.

  1. PIPILY
  2. MIDNIGHT MEDIA
  3. MAGIC RUNNER (GER)

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
SHEIK YERBOUTI was well held on his handicap bow at Ffos Las 3 weeks ago but his maiden third over C&D is strong form for this level so he's worth another chance back at this venue. The Fixer and Henery Hawk head the dangers.

  1. SHEIK YERBOUTI
  2. THE FIXER (IRE)
  3. HENERY HAWK

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
RYE is taken to gain a breakthrough success with Rossa Ryan riding for the first time. Blackjack and Chasing Gold head the dangers.

  1. RYE
  2. BLACKJACK
  3. CHASING GOLD

races.name: Download The Racecourse App Raceday Ready Handicap
races.verdict:
PHAEDRA is worth another chance to confirm the promise of her Doncaster run given more of a break this time. Sansanetti is the obvious threat having landed a gamble in good style on her return to the all-weather last month.

  1. PHAEDRA
  2. SANSANETTI (IRE)
  3. OTTOMAN (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
ZENITH BLAZE's debut was full of promise and with this well-bred filly sure to build on that, she'll take some stopping. Alpine Wedding steps back down in class so seems sure to go well, with Curracloe and Atlantic Rose perhaps the pick of the newcomers.

  1. ZENITH BLAZE
  2. ALPINE WEDDING (IRE)
  3. CURRACLOE (USA)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
DRUMBEAT took a step forward from his debut when third at Leopardstown last time and can build on that and strike at the third time of asking for Aidan O'Brien. The Captains Day made a pleasing start to his career at the Curragh last month and looks the main threat ahead of the selection's stablemate Capability Brown.

  1. DRUMBEAT (IRE)
  2. THE CAPTAINS DAY (IRE)
  3. CAPABILITY BROWN (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
STARBORN LEGEND holds the best form on offer and looks the way to go having not been best placed when fourth at Galway last time. Tourin shaped well under a patient ride on her debut when third in a big-field Limerick maiden and can prove the chief danger, while Hasita and Holy Lettuce appeal as the pick of the remainder for minor honours.

  1. STARBORN LEGEND (IRE)
  2. TOURIN (IRE)
  3. HASITA (IRE)

races.name: 1xBet.ie Proud Supporters Of Irish Racing Handicap
races.verdict:
Successful in a Limerick maiden in June, MOTTA ALTA shaped well starting out for her new yard when third on handicap debut at Galway 5 weeks ago. Still lightly raced and open to further improvement, she can resume winning ways. Ninth Crusade, Lohoobb and Cladach are others fancied to be firmly in the mix.

  1. MOTTA ALTA (IRE)
  2. NINTH CRUSADE (IRE)
  3. LOHOOBB

races.name: Membership At Gowran Park Fillies Claiming Race
races.verdict:
PROFIT SURGE is a consistent sort who is taken to make it 2 wins from as many starts in claiming company on her first outing for a new yard. Minaun View and Star of Beauty head up the opposition.

  1. PROFIT SURGE (IRE)
  2. MINAUN VIEW
  3. STAR OF BEAUTY (IRE)

races.name: Societies Welcome At Gowran Park Apprentice Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
SELECTIVE POWER signalled he is ready to strike again when fourth from a poor draw over C&D on his latest start in June so gets the vote off the same mark. Navajo Point is feared most on the back of a very good Dundalk second, while Miss Americana and Roderick also need factoring into this open handicap.

  1. SELECTIVE POWER (IRE)
  2. NAVAJO POINT (IRE)
  3. MISS AMERICANA

races.name: Support The Irish Injured Jockeys Fund Handicap
races.verdict:
MR PERTH left the impression he is a good deal better than he was able to show on handicap debut at Galway in July and makes plenty of appeal here. She's Ideal and Majestic King head the list of dangers.

  1. MR PERTH (IRE)
  2. SHE'S IDEAL (IRE)
  3. MAJESTIC KING (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again September 19th Maiden
races.verdict:
BARTHOLOMEW has been notably progressive in just 3 starts over hurdles since last seen on the Flat and almost certainly remains capable of better now reverting to this code, so he's a very appealing candidate. Dee Bee Zed went the wrong way from a successful bumper debut but is worth another chance based on the strength of his opening win. Joe Cool can have a say if bouncing back from a lesser effort, while very smart chaser Western Fold is another interesting contender.

  1. BARTHOLOMEW
  2. DEE BEE ZED (IRE)
  3. JOE COOL (IRE)

races.name: Prix Du Camp De Cesar Handicap
Prix De L'etang De Toutevoie Handicap
Prix De La Croix L'oignon Stakes
